title: wholesome shattering polish sausages roast
description: a keto-friendly polish dish featuring roasted sausages with a yuzu-cure and caramelized onions, perfect for a lazy sunday afternoon

ingredients.name: pork sausages
ingredients.notes: look for a keto-friendly polish sausage

instructions: line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
place the sausages on the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch of space between each sausage.
drizzle the top of each sausage with a little bit of yuzu-cure.
roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the sausages are nicely browned and caramelized.
meanwhile, caramelize the onions in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until they are deep golden brown.
after the sausages have roasted for 20 minutes, add the caramelized onions to the baking sheet and return to the oven for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the onions are crispy.
remove the sausages and onions from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
